1aaff604710c637f.job_title: فرصة تعاون مستقل في تطوير الأعمال بالعمولة | الرياض
1aaff604710c637f.description: تبحث شركة في الرياض عن أشخاص للتعاون في التعريف بالشركة وخدماتها لدى الجهات والعملاء المحتملين، وتنسيق الزيارات والاجتماعات، ومتابعة فرص التعاون واستقطاب مشاريع جديدة. آلية التعاون: فرصة تعاون مستقل بالعمولة، وليست وظيفة بدوام أو راتب ثابت. المقابل نسبة متفق عليها عن كل مشروع يتم استقطابه والتعاقد عليه من خلال الطرف المتعاون. يُوثّق التعاون باتفاق مكتوب قبل بدء التواصل مع العملاء، ويُبرم عقد مستقل لكل مشروع يحدد نطاق العمل ونسبة العمولة وأساس احتسابها وشروط استحقاقها ومواعيد صرفها. مرونة في تنظيم الوقت وطريقة أداء العمل، مع تنسيق الاجتماعات والزيارات بحسب مواعيد الجهات المعنية. المهام: الوصول إلى الجهات والعملاء المحتملين والتواصل معهم. تقديم الشركة والتعريف بخدماتها بطريقة احترافية. تنسيق الاجتماعات والزيارات ومتابعة فرص التعاون. توثيق نتائج التواصل والفرص المطروحة. المتطلبات: اللباقة والثقة ومهارات التواصل والعرض والإقناع. المبادرة والقدرة على بناء علاقات مهنية. حسن التنظيم والمتابعة. الاستعداد للاجتماعات والزيارات الميدانية في الرياض. يُفضّل وجود خبرة في تطوير الأعمال أو المبيعات للشركات أو العلاقات العامة. متطلب المقابلة: إعداد محاكاة لعرض تعريفي عن شركة افتراضية من اختيار المتقدم، وتقديمه خلال المقابلة لمدة تتراوح بين ٥ و١٠ دقائق، على ألا يتجاوز ١٠ دقائق، كما لو كان يعرض خدمات الشركة على عميل محتمل. الغرض تقييم مهارات التواصل والعرض والإقناع فقط، ولا يُشترط تصميم احترافي. لن يُستخدم العرض لأغراض تجارية، ولا يُطلب إعداد مواد تخص شركتنا أو عملاءها. التقديم متاح للرجال والنساء.

1a9eb02a3408c0bc.description: About the Role UCC Holding is seeking an experienced General Foreman (Fit-Out) to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves supporting the successful delivery of Luxury Hospitality, High-End Interior Fit-Out, VIP, and Commercial Fit-Out Projects. The General Foreman will be responsible for supervising daily site activities, coordinating subcontractors and trades, ensuring quality workmanship, maintaining productivity, and enforcing HSE compliance to deliver projects on schedule and to the highest standards. Key Responsibilities Supervise and coordinate all fit-out and interior finishing activities on site. Manage and direct site workforce, subcontractors, and specialist trades to ensure smooth project execution. Ensure all works comply with approved shop drawings, specifications, method statements, and project requirements. Monitor site progress and ensure activities are completed according to project schedules and milestones. Coordinate with Project Engineers, Site Engineers, QA/QC, and HSE teams to resolve site issues and maintain workflow. Ensure high-quality workmanship and minimize rework through effective site supervision and inspections. Monitor material usage, manpower allocation, and equipment utilization to maximize productivity and control costs. Review and verify installation works including architectural finishes, gypsum works, ceilings, joinery, marble, stone, flooring, wall finishes, and decorative elements. Ensure compliance with project quality standards, company procedures, and client requirements. Identify and report construction issues, delays, and potential risks to the site management team. Enforce HSE requirements and ensure all personnel comply with safety regulations and site procedures. Maintain daily progress records and coordinate site activities to achieve project objectives. Qualifications and Experience High School Diploma or Technical Certification in a relevant field. Minimum of 5 years of construction experience, with at least 3 years in Fit-Out supervision roles. GCC experience is highly preferred. Proven experience in Luxury Hotels, Hospitality, High-End Residential, Commercial Fit-Out, or VIP Projects. Strong knowledge of fit-out construction methods, materials, and finishing works. Ability to read and interpret IFC Drawings, Shop Drawings, and Interior Fit-Out Details. Experience managing subcontractors and multiple trades on-site. Good understanding of QA/QC procedures and HSE requirements. Strong leadership, communication, and coordination skills. SAP or ERP system knowledge is an advantage. Preferred Project Experience Luxury Hotels & Resorts Hospitality Projects VIP Projects High-End Interior Fit-Out Commercial Fit-Out Luxury Residential Developments Mixed-Use Developments Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, focusing on high-end fit-out projects within the luxury hospitality and commercial sectors.

1a1ee2df3711bf4f.description: About the Role SummerTown Real Estate is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Chief Operating Officer (COO) to join their team in Riyadh. This full-time leadership position is crucial for overseeing operational activities, enhancing organizational performance, and driving the execution of both operational and strategic plans within the real estate development sector to achieve company objectives. Supervise real estate development projects and monitor their implementation phases. Improve the efficiency of internal operations and procedures, enhancing productivity. Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) to ensure the achievement of defined objectives. Manage operational resources and budgets, focusing on cost efficiency. Proven leadership experience in managing teams, departments, and overseeing operational processes. Strong knowledge of the real estate development sector and project management. High-level skills in strategic planning, organization, and decision-making. Ability to analyze performance, develop procedures, and improve results. Effective leadership and communication skills, with experience in stakeholder management. Education Bachelor's degree in Business Administration. Bachelor's degree in Engineering. Bachelor's degree in Project Management. Compensation The salary for this position is up to 20,000 Saudi Riyals, commensurate with experience and qualifications. 1a853bdcaa115496.description: About the Role ENGIE Saudi Arabia is seeking an Electrical Technician to join their team in Al Jubayl, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves performing essential maintenance, troubleshooting, and testing of electrical equipment and systems within a Combined Cycle Power Plant (CCPP) and an associated Desalination Plant. The primary objective is to ensure the safe, reliable, and efficient operation of electrical assets, thereby supporting continuous power and water production. Key Responsibilities Perform preventive, predictive, and corrective maintenance activities on major electrical systems, adhering to OEM manuals and industry best practices. Conduct independent troubleshooting to identify and rectify electrical defects. Collaborate with Plant Operations Personnel to resolve control equipment issues under the guidance of the Electrical Foreman/Engineer. Organize necessary spares, tools, and equipment for maintenance tasks. Ensure compliance with the Integrated Management System (IMS) and all company rules and procedures. Record and report all undertaken preventive and corrective maintenance jobs to the Foreman. Update the Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS) after each activity. Obtain all required permit authorizations for electrical systems. Safety and Compliance Ensure a safe working environment for self and colleagues when working on any equipment. Possess practical knowledge of plant isolations from system hazards and sufficient understanding of health & safety practices. Support departmental efforts to improve safety culture. Participate in safety meetings, toolbox talks, and incident investigations. Required Skills and Attributes Ability to perform duties with minimal supervision. Strong collaboration skills to work effectively with other Electrical Technicians. Commitment to continuous development through technical training programs. Residency in Al Jubail is preferred to ensure quick response in case of emergencies. Physical Requirements and Work Environment The Electrical Technician role operates within demanding power plant conditions, requiring strong physical and mental resilience. Candidates must be medically fit to work in environments that may include exposure to high voltage, heat, noise, and confined spaces. The role requires: Sufficient strength and stamina for extended periods of standing, walking, and climbing during inspections. Ability to work at heights and in elevated areas, including scaffolds and overhead cranes. Capability to lift and handle electrical tools and equipment weighing up to 20–25 kg. Good vision (with corrective lenses if needed) and hearing to monitor electrical systems and alarms safely. Strong hand-eye coordination and dexterity for handling electrical components. Ability to respond promptly and physically in emergency or fault conditions, including rapid movement to safe locations. Tolerance for rotating shifts, extended working hours, emergency callouts, and physically demanding schedules as dictated by plant operational needs. Freedom from medical conditions that could impair alertness, balance, or safe performance of electrical duties. Application Process Candidates who meet the outlined requirements are encouraged to apply for this full-time position.

1af8f2c4e83cfee6.description: About the Role Al Salama Hospital is seeking an RCM Quality Assurance Analyst to join their team in Makkah or Jeddah. This full-time role focuses on ensuring revenue integrity through data analysis, quality audits, and comprehensive reporting across the revenue cycle. The analyst will be instrumental in maintaining high standards of data quality and compliance. Role Overview The RCM Quality Assurance Analyst is responsible for supporting the financial health of the hospital by meticulously analyzing revenue cycle data. This includes identifying trends, conducting audits, and reporting findings to leadership to drive continuous improvement and ensure adherence to regulatory standards. The position requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Extract, validate, and report on RCM data, covering claims, billing, approvals, denials, and reconciliation processes. Conduct quality assurance audits and monitor corrective actions through to completion. Develop and maintain RCM KPI dashboards, analyzing denial and payer trends to identify areas for improvement. Present audit findings and recommendations clearly to RCM leadership. Support compliance with CHI, MOH, CBAHI, and JCI standards, as well as NPHIES data quality initiatives. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor’s degree in Health Informatics, Data Analytics, Statistics, Finance, or Health Information Management (HIM). A Master’s degree or CPHQ certification is preferred. A minimum of 3 years of experience in data analysis, quality assurance, or reporting within healthcare RCM or hospital administration. Demonstrated experience with RCM dashboards and audit frameworks is required. Work Location This full-time position is based in either Jeddah or Makkah. Application Process Interested candidates are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

1a37b97bc358f045.description: About the Role Schneider Electric is seeking a Building Segment Sales Lead to drive growth within the Central Region, specifically in Riyadh. 1a81ed2e4e21d162.description: About the Internship KEO Group is offering a Project Admin internship opportunity within its PMO Division at the Riyadh office in Saudi Arabia. This internship is designed for students pursuing a degree and provides practical experience in project administration within a professional environment. The role requires 0-1 years of experience and is structured as an internship. With over 60 years of experience, KEO has contributed to significant projects worldwide. The company is recognized by ENR as one of the Top 225 International Design Firms and one of the Top 20 International PM/CM Firms. World Architecture ranks KEO as the 51st largest global architecture firm and the #1 Firm in the Middle East Region in their 2024 WA100 Survey. Key Responsibilities Reviewing the PMO Charter and Project Procedures Manual (PPM). Rotating through various PMO desks for practical exposure. Learning to use SharePoint and BMS systems. Collaborating with Learning & Development to establish a learning plan. Attending online corporate training sessions. Maintaining staff deployment (SDRS) and leave trackers. Following open positions from request to mobilization. Supporting the follow-up of new joiner mobilization steps. Formatting CVs for bids. Managing timesheets and internal resource transfers. Following a complete invoicing cycle, including month-end closure, invoice (IPA) preparation, submission, client approval, and cash receipt. Updating billing and cash receipt trackers. Following up on supporting documents. Logging variations. Supporting the 25th-of-month data collection from project teams. Checking monthly reports and forecasts for completeness. Supporting the preparation of the portfolio dashboard. Learning to read project programs using Primavera P6. Attending Monthly Progress Reviews (MPRs). Assisting with project delivery compliance checks against the PPM checklist. Organizing document registers and SharePoint filing. Observing live bids, where applicable. The company's success is built on integrity, innovation, collaboration, safety, and its people. Application Process All applications and expressions of interest will be treated with confidentiality. KEO welcomes candidates who can contribute to its team.

1a967a6990db766f.description: About Ghithaa Ghithaa (غِذاء) is a company operating in the food industry, committed to maintaining high standards of food safety and quality. We are seeking a dedicated Quality Controller to join our team in Makkah, with operations spanning Jeddah and Riyadh. This is a full-time position for professionals with 2-5 years of relevant experience. Role Overview The Quality Controller is responsible for upholding stringent food safety, quality, and hygiene standards across all operational stages. This includes production, central kitchen activities, storage, packing, dispatch, and delivery processes. The role ensures compliance with established protocols and regulatory requirements to maintain product integrity. Key Responsibilities Monitor adherence to HACCP, GMP, food safety, and hygiene standards throughout operations. Conduct inspections of incoming raw materials, production processes, finished products, packing, and labelling. Monitor food temperatures and ensure effective cold-chain controls are maintained. Verify portion sizes, product specifications, and overall quality standards. Perform quality checks prior to dispatch and during delivery. Manage non-conformities, implement Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA), conduct root-cause analysis, and apply corrective measures. Support investigations into customer complaints and assist with food safety audits. Maintain accurate records for quality and food safety, and prepare daily reports. Ensure full compliance with SFDA requirements and company Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs). Required Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 2 to 5 years of experience in quality control, preferably within the food industry. Demonstrated knowledge of HACCP, GMP, and food safety regulations. Ability to conduct detailed inspections and maintain meticulous records. Strong analytical skills for root-cause analysis and problem-solving. Work Environment and Location This full-time position is based in the Makkah region, with responsibilities extending to operations in Jeddah and Riyadh. The role involves working across various operational areas including production, central kitchen, storage, and logistics to ensure comprehensive quality oversight. Application Process Candidates who meet the specified requirements are encouraged to apply. The salary for this position will be discussed during the interview process.

1adcfd623933d2e1.description: About Mozn MOZN is a leading Enterprise AI company enabling organizations to make informed decisions in two critical domains: Financial Crime Prevention and Enterprise Knowledge Intelligence. We’re a diverse, collaborative team of innovators united by a shared purpose: to build AI that delivers tangible business value, builds trust, and empowers people and organizations with augmented intelligence. Our culture is built on the relentless pursuit of excellence and meaningful impact. If you’re passionate about working alongside exceptional talent on world-class AI, and you want the autonomy and runway to do the best work of your career, join us in shaping the future of intelligent enterprises About the role As a Revenue Operations Analyst you will be a key member of our Revenue Operations team' Deal Desk Processes. You will be responsible for driving operational excellence across the deal lifecycle. You will partner closely with Sales, Legal, Finance, Cybersecurity and Product teams to ensure deals are structured effectively, priced accurately, and executed efficiently in alignment with company policies and revenue goals. You will be responsible for managing the end-to-end quote-to-close process, supporting complex deal structuring, and ensuring compliance with commercial terms and revenue recognition policies. This role requires a balance of analytical skills, process discipline, and business acumen to enable the commercial unit to close deals faster and with higher quality. In line with Saudization requirements, we are currently prioritizing Saudi national candidates for this position. What you'll do Support the Commercial team on deal structuring, pricing strategy, and contract terms. Draft, update, and manage customer contracts, including order forms, addendums, and renewals. Act as a point of contact for the commercial team for customer requests related to Legal, Finance, and Cybersecurity. Review and approve non-standard deal requests while ensuring alignment with internal policies and revenue guidelines. Collaborate with Legal, Finance, Cybersecurity, and Product teams to ensure deal compliance, risk mitigation, and proper revenue treatment. Support the Commercial leadership initiatives to streamline quote-to-cash processes and improve pricing governance. Maintain accurate deal data in CRM systems and generate insights to improve forecasting accuracy and sales efficiency. Develop and optimize deal approval workflows to increase sales velocity. Manage internal approval workflows for discounts, exceptions, or special terms. Requirements Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Engineering, or any related field. 2+ years of experience in sales operations, revenue operations, sales support, or a similar role. Excellent analytical and communication skills, with the ability to balance strategic thinking and attention to detail. Experience with CRM platforms (Salesforce) as well as contract management tools. Strong understanding of different business models, pricing structures, and revenue recognition principles. Experience working in SaaS or technology companies. Highly organized with great attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines. Strong understanding of sales processes and metrics, with the ability to optimize and improve processes. Must be fluent in both written and spoken English and Arabic. Benefits You will be at the forefront of an exciting time for the Middle East, joining a high-growth rocket-ship in an exciting space. You will be given a lot of responsibility and trust. We believe that the best results come when the people responsible for a function are given the freedom to do what they think is best. The fundamentals will be taken care of: competitive compensation, top-tier health insurance, and an enabling culture so that you can focus on what you do best. You will enjoy a fun and dynamic workplace working alongside some of the greatest minds in AI. We believe strength lies in difference, embracing all for who they are and empowered to be the best version of themselves.

This full-time role involves researching, designing, developing, and analyzing specialty systems such as Signaling and Imaging, Radio Frequency, and Optical systems. 1a8601d42e580c3e.description: About the Role Namaa Partners is seeking a Data Analyst to join its team in Saudi Arabia. This full-time, remote position is open to candidates located anywhere in Saudi Arabia, specifically within the Makkah region, including Jeddah and Makkah cities. The role is integral to an operating performance project with a corporate group in Saudi Arabia and subsequent engagements. Role Context The Data Analyst will be responsible for transforming client data related to sales, costs, staffing, and operations into structured tables, comprehensive dashboards, and concise findings. These insights will then be utilized by Namaa Partners' consultants for presentation to management. Collaboration with a team based in Oklahoma City will require some calls towards the end of the working day, accounting for an eight to nine-hour time difference from Riyadh. Key Responsibilities Collect data extracts from clients' finance, HR, and operations systems, and verify them for completeness and accuracy. Clean, join, and reshape data using Excel, SQL, or Python to enable comparisons across business units and fiscal years. Develop Power BI dashboards that visualize performance measures agreed upon for each client engagement. Prepare concise notes explaining changes observed in the data and their underlying reasons. Document all data sources, assumptions, and adjustments to ensure traceability and auditability of work. About Namaa Partners Namaa Partners is a management consulting firm headquartered in Oklahoma City. The firm provides advisory services to corporate groups, family enterprises, and their boards on matters of strategy, governance, and operating performance. Work Environment and Compensation This is a full-time, remote position within Saudi Arabia. The role offers a monthly salary paid in Saudi riyals. Candidates should be prepared for potential evening calls to align with the US-based team's working hours.

1a9a7a335c135aa0.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة سلطان سليمان الشمري عن موظف صندوق محاسبة للانضمام إلى فريقها في ينبع، المدينة المنورة. يركز هذا الدور على إدارة المعاملات النقدية والائتمانية بدقة، وضمان سير العمليات المالية بسلاسة وفعالية. تتطلب الوظيفة خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة وهي بدوام كامل. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية عدّ وتسجيل المبالغ المالية في آلة تسجيل النقود في بداية وردية العمل، مع ضمان توفر كمية كافية من العملات الصغيرة. استلام المدفوعات نقداً أو عن طريق بطاقة الائتمان أو أي طرق دفع أخرى معتمدة، ودفع المبالغ المتبقية وتحرير الإيصالات المناسبة. تحديث قوائم الأسعار بشكل مستمر، وحساب أسعار السلع أو الخدمات، وإعداد جداول الفواتير، وتطبيق الخصومات عند اللزوم. تسوية النقدية الواردة مع إجمالي المبيعات في نهاية الوردية، والإبلاغ عن أية اختلافات أو تسويتها. التعامل مع العملاء بمهنية وتلبية رغباتهم فيما يتعلق بإضافة أو حذف عناصر من قوائم الشراء. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على التعامل مع المعاملات النقدية والائتمانية بدقة. مهارات جيدة في خدمة العملاء والتواصل الفعال. بيئة العمل يقع مكان العمل في مدينة ينبع بمنطقة المدينة المنورة، ويوفر بيئة عمل بدوام كامل ضمن فريق مؤسسة سلطان سليمان الشمري. يتطلب الدور التزاماً بالدقة والتعامل المباشر مع العملاء. معلومات إضافية هذه فرصة للانضمام إلى فريق عمل في مؤسسة سلطان سليمان الشمري، حيث يمكن للمرشحين الجدد اكتساب خبرة قيمة في مجال المحاسبة وإدارة الصندوق. الراتب غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة.

1a81466ce3df071f.description: About the Role Guerlain is seeking a Marketing Brand Manager to develop and execute the local marketing strategy for the brand across the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. This full-time role, based in Jeddah and Makkah, ensures alignment with regional and global brand vision. The manager will lead 360° marketing campaigns, product launches, media activations, retail animations, influencer partnerships, CRM initiatives, and client engagement strategies to drive brand desirability and business growth. Key Responsibilities Develop and execute the annual marketing plan for the Saudi market, aligning with regional and global objectives. Adapt international campaigns to local market needs while maintaining brand consistency. Manage the execution of product launches, seasonal campaigns, and retail marketing initiatives. Monitor campaign performance and optimize activities based on business results and market insights. Collaborate with retail and commercial teams to drive traffic, sales, and brand awareness. Define and develop annual retail marketing and wholesale trade marketing plans in collaboration with local commercial and regional trade marketing teams. Ensure strong in-store execution across all Guerlain counters and boutiques, coordinating with Visual Merchandising. Uphold and implement regional PR guidelines locally, supporting press and influencer activities as needed. 1a95dbea244ea4d8.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مصنع القمه للاثاث والديكورات الخشبيه عن سكرتير للانضمام إلى فريق العمل في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى تقديم الدعم الإداري للمدير أو الإدارة من خلال إدارة الوثائق والمكالمات والزوار، والمساعدة في تنسيق المشاريع الأساسية وجدولة المواعيد. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تدوين الملاحظات المكتوبة بطريقة الاختزال، ونسخ المراسلات والتقارير ومحاضر الاجتماعات، ومراجعتها وتنسيقها وفقاً لمعايير المكتب. تلقي المكالمات الهاتفية من الموظفين والعملاء الخارجيين وفرزها وتوجيهها، واستلام الرسائل الهاتفية، والإجابة على أسئلة المتصلين، وتحويل المكالمات إلى الشخص المناسب. التعامل مع البريد الوارد والصادر، وفحص المراسلات البريدية وتسجيلها وتوزيعها. فحص طلبات الاجتماعات والمواعيد، وتنسيق جداول المشاركين، وتحديد أوقات الاجتماعات، وتأمين قاعة الاجتماعات، وتحضير جدول الأعمال. إنشاء أنظمة لحفظ الملفات والسجلات وصيانتها، وحفظ جميع المستندات بشكل منتظم. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال السكرتارية أو الدعم الإداري. القدرة على كتابة الوثائق وإدارة المهام الإدارية بكفاءة. مهارات تنظيمية وجدولة ممتازة. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تواصل شفهي وكتابي قوية. القدرة على التعامل مع المكالمات الهاتفية والزوار بمهنية. إتقان استخدام برامج الحاسوب المكتبية. القدرة على إدارة الوقت وتحديد الأولويات. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مصنع القمه للاثاث والديكورات الخشبيه بمدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة. يتطلب الدور العمل ضمن فريق لتقديم الدعم الإداري الفعال. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده ومناقشته خلال عملية التوظيف.

Key Responsibilities Establish enterprise standards, frameworks, and reference architectures for OT data ingestion, transformation, and integration. Define scalable patterns for consistent access to operational data across sites, systems, and platforms. Deliver resilient OT data pipelines to ensure reliable, timely, and accurate operational data availability. Improve data consistency through robust handling of reconciliation, latency, backfill, quality validation, and exception management. Embed governance, lineage, auditability, and quality controls throughout the OT data lifecycle. Strengthen compliance with OT security, segmentation, and enterprise data governance requirements. Enable the creation of trusted OT data products that support analytics, reporting, operational monitoring, and AI use cases. Drive standardization of data models, tag structures, quality indicators, and transformation logic across industrial environments. Provide architectural guidance for complex OT integration and engineering initiatives across multiple sites. Govern engineering quality by establishing technical standards, design reviews, and delivery assurance mechanisms. Advance OT data engineering capabilities through the adoption of modern engineering practices and technologies. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of relevant experience in engineering and ETL within Operational Technology environments. Demonstrated ability to establish enterprise standards and frameworks for data ingestion and integration. Experience in designing and implementing resilient data pipelines with robust data quality and exception management. Proficiency in data governance, security, and compliance within OT data lifecycles. Experience in enabling data products for analytics, reporting, and AI use cases. Strong technical leadership skills, including architectural guidance and quality assurance. Expected Outcomes Success in this role will be measured by the consistent availability, trustworthiness, and accessibility of OT data across enterprise analytics and operational platforms. The role will ensure that governance, lineage, security, and auditability requirements are embedded within OT data engineering processes, and that operational data products effectively support business decision-making and advanced analytics initiatives. Consistent adoption of OT-to-IT integration standards and improved engineering quality and platform scalability are also key indicators of success.

1a82e595845e8ead.description: Eram Talent is seeking a proactive and detail-oriented IT Administrative Analyst to support the day-to-day administration, reliability, and continuity of digital systems, user devices, and classroom technology. Maintain accurate documentation of systems, devices, licences, warranties, and vendor support activities. Coordinate with external vendors for hardware, software, and AV support services. Support continuity planning, system security, and incident response in accordance with organisational policies. Familiarity with Google Workspace, Student Information Systems (SIS), Learning Management Systems (LMS), or similar platforms. Experience supporting audio-visual equipment and classroom technology is an advantage. Strong organisational, documentation, and problem-solving skills. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to support non-technical users. Previous experience in an educational or school environment is preferred.

1a9ae03a0e806f07.description: المهام والمسئوليات الرئيسية: عمل ملف صحي لجميع المستفيدين (قياس الوزن والطول .. الخ) بشكل مجدول والمشاركة بدراسة الحالة. متابعة مدى خلو المستفيدين من الأمراض المعدية وإعداد تقرير صحي عن أنظمة حماية المستفيدين والتدابير المتخذة ضد انتقال أي عدوى. إجراء المسح الطبي لدراسة الحالة وتدوين الملاحظات المهمة والحالات التي بحاجة إلى متابعة دائمة. متابعة الكشف الطبي ومدى لياقة المستفيدين الملتحقين بالمركز. متابعة تلقي المستفيدين للتطعيمات الضرورية حسب جدولتها. المشاركة بالتوعية الصحية للأهل والعناية بصحة الفم والأمراض الشائعة وسبل الوقاية. حصر المستفيدين الذين تحت رعاية طبية مؤقتة والمتابعة مع الأهل. متابعة الحصول على إقرار موافقة ولي الأمر في حال كان المستفيد يتلقى جرعة أي دواء في المركز وتدوين الوقت المحدد والجرعة. حصر المستفيدين الذين يعانون من صرع أو تشنجات وتدريب الأخصائي/ة في حال حصول أي موقف طارئ وكيفية عمل الإسعافات الأولية إلى حين حضور الممرض/ة. حصر الحالات التي تعاني من أمراض مزمنة بشكل دوري (مشكلات بالقلب أو داء السكري أو ربو) وعزل المستفيدين المصابين بالربو في مكان ذو تهوية جيدة عند حصول أي طارئ بالجو. حصر الحالات التي تعاني من حساسية من الأدوية أو حساسية من الطعام والتواصل مع الأهل وتحديد الإجراء المتبع في حال تعرض المستفيد لحساسية وتدوينها بالنموذج المعتمد. المتابعة والتنسيق مع مختصي البرامج المساندة التي تتطلب مجهود عضلي من المستفيد/ة وتوضيح حالته الصحية ونوعية التدريبات الملائمة مع وضعه الصحي. متابعة المستفيدين في حال المرض أو الحرارة أو أي حادث عرضي (القيام بالإسعافات الأولية) أو أي إجراء يلزم نقل المستفيد/ة لجهة خارجية والتنسيق مع القسم في تبليغ أو طلب الأهل. إعداد تقرير أسبوعي بالحالات الطارئة وما تم ورفعه لمدير/ة الفرع والطبيب/ة المباشر. المساعدة في التوعية بأساليب التغذية العلاجية والغذاء الصحي. متابعة الأدوية والآثار الجانبية لها على المستفيد/ة وإعداد تقرير شهري بذلك. إعداد تقرير شهري للتدخلات التي تمت ونوعية الإصابات التي حدثت. متابعة إمدادات صناديق الإسعافات الأولية وصيانة المعدات الخاصة بالقسم الطبي والرفع لتوفيرها أو صيانتها. إعداد تقارير فصلية وسنوية عن الخدمات الطبية التي قُدمت للحالات داخل المركز. تدريب الموظفين والعاملين الذين لهم تعامل مباشر مع المستفيدين في التعامل مع الحالات المرضية (الصرع، السكر، الربو، الرعاف ...الخ). القيام بأي مهام يتم التكليف بها وتدخل ضمن المجال الصحي. الدعم النفسي والمعنوي للمستفيدين وأسرهم. الالتزام بسياسة الشركة فيما يخص الملفات والتقارير. استلام العهد والأدوات والمحافظة عليها والتبليغ في حال التلف. الالتزام بحضور الدورات التدريبية والاجتماعات المعلنة من قبل الشركة. حضور الفعاليات التي تسهم في تحسين صورة المركز وتبرز دور القسم ودمج المستفيد/ة بالمجتمع. الممرض/ة ملزم بكل ما ورد في لوائح الشركة والمركز وكل ما يكلفه به المشرف/ة من مهام. التعاون والتفاعل مع روح الفريق. الالتزام بساعات العمل. الكفاءات والمهارات: المؤهلات العلمية: بكالوريوس تمريض. تصنيف هيئة التخصصات الصحية. المهارات الشخصية: القدرة على التعامل مع الحالات الطارئة وعمل الإجراء المناسب للحالة. مهارات حل المشكلات واتخاذ القرارات بعد أخذ اعتماد المشرف/ة. مهارات تنظيمية قوية وإدارة الوقت. القدرة على العمل تحت الضغط والتعامل مع التحديات الميدانية. المهارات التقنية: إجادة استخدام الحاسب الآلي وبرامج Microsoft Office والتطبيقات التقنية. المهارات التواصلية: مهارات ممتازة في التعاون والتفاعل مع الفريق التأهيلي. المحافظة على سرية المستفيدين.
